1 * htmlFindEncoding: 2 * @the HTML parser context 3 * 4 * Ty to find and encoding in the current data available in the input 5 * buffer this is needed to try to switch to the proper encoding when 6 * one face a character error. 7 * That's an heuristic, since it's operating outside of parsing it could 8 * try to use a meta which had been commented out, that's the reason it 9 * should only be used in case of error, not as a default. 10 * 11 * Returns an encoding string or NULL if not found, the string need to 12 * be freed 13 */ 14 static xmlChar * 15 htmlFindEncoding(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt) { 16 const xmlChar *start, *cur, *end; 17 18 if ((ctxt == NULL) || (ctxt->input == NULL) || 19 (ctxt->input->flags & XML_INPUT_HAS_ENCODING)) 20 return(NULL); 21 if ((ctxt->input->cur == NULL) || (ctxt->input->end == NULL)) 22 return(NULL); 23 24 start = ctxt->input->cur; 25 end = ctxt->input->end; 26 /* we also expect the input buffer to be zero terminated */ 27 if (*end != 0) 28 return(NULL); 29 30 cur = xmlStrcasestr(start, BAD_CAST "HTTP-EQUIV"); 31 if (cur == NULL) 32 return(NULL); 33 cur = xmlStrcasestr(cur, BAD_CAST "CONTENT"); 34 if (cur == NULL) 35 return(NULL); 36 cur = xmlStrcasestr(cur, BAD_CAST "CHARSET="); 37 if (cur == NULL) 38 return(NULL); 39 cur += 8; 40 start = cur; 41 while (((*cur >= 'A') && (*cur <= 'Z')) || 42 ((*cur >= 'a') && (*cur <= 'z')) || 43 ((*cur >= '0') && (*cur <= '9')) || 44 (*cur == '-') || (*cur == '_') || (*cur == ':') || (*cur == '/')) 45 cur++; --- submit harness? --- grep: ./.git/objects/pack/pack-a2c0dffb914f78118c008ee75acc4fadd18c7300.pack: binary file matches ./result/schemas/oss-fuzz-51295_0_0.err:1:./test/schemas/oss-fuzz-51295_0.xsd:2: element element: Schemas parser error : element decl.
